title: Speed up the selectable story review tree tests

intentCoverage.report:
## Intent Coverage for SEED-446#ad-hoc-work

**Verdict. Caught.** The switching-comparisons case fails if Intent drops the configured locations for a captured run while keeping the inventory and source. The maintained assertion at line 138 expected the `previous` folder row to have `data-intent-folder-cue="root"` and received `null`. The earlier assertion that `previous/old.spec.ts` was visible passed. [Maintained case](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/dd01a682ca08c309bcc230be65ea9de754f25e58/dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-story-result-browser.spec.ts#L113)

**Fault and observation.** At accepted revision `dd01a682ca08c309bcc230be65ea9de754f25e58`, an isolated detached worktree temporarily returned `noLocations` from `useStoryResultBrowse` only for a pin with a captured reference. The test fixtures and assertions stayed intact. The fixture supplied `checks/current.spec.ts` for the published completion, `previous/old.spec.ts` for the capture, and different guide text for the captured revision. The failure screenshot independently showed the captured run selected, the old spec in the inventory, and the captured guide at revision `eeeeeee`. The `previous` row appeared without its configured-root background. [Fault location](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/dd01a682ca08c309bcc230be65ea9de754f25e58/dashboard/src/useStoryResultRead.tsx#L141) · [Fault screenshot](/tmp/open-dough-review-speed-intent-coverage.lHkaws/fault.png)

**Run and restoration.** Ran `caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- intent-story-result-browser.spec.ts --grep 'switching comparisons changes the inventory' --workers=1 --reporter=verbose` three times. The selected case passed at baseline, failed at the intended assertion with the fault, and passed after restoration. The restored worktree matched its clean pre-probe state and was removed.

**Next proof action.** Keep the configured-root assertion. This check found no need for stronger proof of the specific captured-settings regression. No separate planned repair was identified.

- **Test runtime.** 11.07 s measured by the runner across baseline, fault, and restored runs of 4.39 s, 3.43 s, and 3.25 s. The selected case took 273 ms, 536 ms, and 200 ms respectively. The three other cases were outside this selection.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. Human effort was not measured in this check.
- **Agent effort.** Approximately one minute estimated from active inspection, scratch setup, fault application, output verification, and report preparation.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 95110 ms (measured), from 1795750353000 to 1795750448110 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** At `dd01a682ca08c309bcc230be65ea9de754f25e58`, the check caught the removed settings. The existing assertion covers this fault. No follow-up was queued.
